answer: Require every agent identity to stake a bond and earn attestations from already-trusted peers before it can transact. A sybil farm can spin up thousands of hollow identities, but it cannot bridge them into the trust graph without paying the bond per identity and earning real attestations, which costs time and reputation. Like a ridge path with one guarded crossing, the entry cost rises linearly with each fake while honest agents pay once, so flooding the network stops paying off.
